mapper.select: SELECT tl.travel_id AS travelId, tl.user_id AS userId, tl.account_id AS accountId, tl.title AS title, tl.travel_begin_date AS travelBeginDate, tl.travel_end_date AS travelEndDate, tl.destination AS destination, tl.is_generated AS isGenerated, tl.travel_img AS travelImg FROM travel_log tl WHERE tl.travel_id = #{travelId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(t.transaction_type))='WITHDRAW' THEN ABS(t.amount) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpense, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(t.transaction_type))='WITHDRAW' AND UPPER(TRIM(t.category))='FOOD' THEN ABS(t.amount) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalFood, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(t.transaction_type))='WITHDRAW' AND UPPER(TRIM(t.category))='CULTURE' THEN ABS(t.amount) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalActivity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(t.transaction_type))='WITHDRAW' AND UPPER(TRIM(t.category))='ACCOMMODATION' THEN ABS(t.amount) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalAcc, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(t.transaction_type))='WITHDRAW' AND UPPER(TRIM(t.category))='TRANSPORTATION' THEN ABS(t.amount) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalTransport, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(t.transaction_type))='WITHDRAW' AND UPPER(TRIM(t.category))='SHOPPING' THEN ABS(t.amount) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalShop FROM `transaction` t WHERE t.account_id = #{param.accountId} AND t.user_id = #{param.userId} AND t.created_at >= #{param.startDateTime} AND t.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{param.endDateTime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_log SET is_generated = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE travel_id = #{travelId} AND is_generated = 0
